title: 第5章 提升
slug: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
lines: 陈峰掂了掂手中的颚片。
两片巴掌长的金属化颚叶。
灰黑色泽，边缘锋利，这东西在市面上属于低级武器材料，正常来讲能卖两三千。
他将颚片收进个人空间，又蹲下身，用工兵铲沿着铁鄂灰蜚的躯干，把几片还算完好的甲壳给卸了下来。
甲壳不太好售卖，但留着以后或许能自制防具。
他那件三万多的防护服，刚才被一口就咬穿了，总得想办法加固一下。
做完这些，陈峰站起身，抬头看向走廊尽头的楼梯口。
天台就在上面，几步就能上去。
但问题是……天台上有没有铁鄂灰蜚？
刚才那只虫子给他的压力太大了，二十公斤的体重，金属化的口器，极快的爆发速度。
一对一他或许能赢。
可要是上去之后，两只、三只一起扑过来……
他现在右臂有伤，白浊弹也只剩一次半的量，真被围了，怕是连逃回现实的反应时间都未必有。
陈峰站在原地，盯着那个黑洞洞的楼梯口，脑子飞速转动，片刻后，他有了主意。
工兵铲的铲面贴上墙壁，轻轻敲了三下。
铛、铛、铛。
声音不大，在空旷的走廊里传出去，又被四面的水泥墙弹回来。
陈峰屏住呼吸，侧耳倾听。
如果天台上有铁鄂灰蜚，那这种动静应该能够引起他们的注意。
时间缓缓推移。
五秒，十秒，三十秒……
楼梯口一片安静。
陈峰又敲了一轮，这次稍微重了些，依旧没有动静。
“看来是没有了。”
陈峰松了口气，握紧工兵铲，半蹲身子，小心翼翼的摸上楼梯。
楼梯尽头是一扇锈迹斑斑的铁门，门锁已经腐坏。
陈峰侧身贴在门框边，先探头扫了一眼。
门外是一座天台。
将近有一百朵平方，地面堆着各种腐朽的杂物，断裂的晾衣架、碎裂的花盆、一台早已报废的空调外机。
确实没有虫子。
陈峰这才推开铁门，走了出去。
天空中那苍白的月光照下来，勉强照亮了天台中的一切。
他目光扫过一圈，最终落在西北角。
那里有一片废弃的花圃，外围是一圈碎裂的水泥围栏，里面的泥土漆黑，表面还覆盖着一层细密的灰白色菌丝。
而菌丝之上，生长着一丛密密麻麻挤在一起的灰伞肺菇，少说有二十株！
novel_title: 我有一个黑暗密武世界
content_zh:
出租屋里。

    陈峰靠着沙发摘下头盔，扯掉防毒面罩，又平复了一会儿呼吸，紧绷神经才渐渐松弛下来。

    脑海中忍不住回忆起，刚刚所见到的那头巨大竹节怪物，

    以及看到那怪物时，感受到那种钻入脑海的冰冷黏腻感觉。

    他很确定自己查到的异种生物资料中，没有这种看一眼就能影响精神的怪物。

    “这难道是……污染？”

    陈峰想到一种可能。

    实际上，

    生物在高灵气环境下的异化其本质是进化，是在挖掘基因深处的优良性状。

    而网上曾有传言，在现实世界的禁区深处灵气浓度越高的地方，就越有可能出现一种污染……

    或者叫“畸变”更合适。

    会将生物的进化引向某种不可名状的方向。

    这类生物一般都极为危险，拥有种种千奇百怪、不可思议的能力。

    要知道，现实世界禁区灵气浓度也才正常三倍左右。

    如果这则传言为真，那眼下这个灵气浓度达到五倍的大墟世界，恐怕存在着更多恐怖怪物……

    陈峰晃了晃脑袋，暂时压下了心中念头，算了多想无益。

    他低头看了看右前臂伤口，已经被天衡喷雾封住，只剩一层白色药膜覆在上面，隐隐发痒。

    显然是已经在修复了，应该要不了两天就能康复。

    陈峰收回视线，打开面板看了一眼。

    【基础格斗术Lv.1经验：85/100】

    嗯，涨了三点？

    陈峰回忆了一下，他记得，自己进入大墟世界之前，格斗术的经验值是82点。

    也就是说刚才和那只铁鄂灰蜚的搏杀，直接涨了3点经验！

    陈峰目光微微一亮。

    要知道，他前段时间在学校上训练课的时候，

    一节课九十分钟，对练加上实操，累的半死，经验值纹丝不动。

    有时候连续上一周的课才能涨个一两点。

    结果在大墟里跟一只蟑螂拼了一场命，三点就到手了。

    “生死之间出真知啊……”

    陈峰咂了咂嘴，这倒也能理解。

    课堂上的训练再怎么模拟实战，终究还是安全的，身体知道自己不会死，潜能就逼不出来。

    但在大墟里不一样。

    每一次生死搏杀肾上腺素飙升，身体每一块肌肉，每一根神经都在极限运转，格斗技巧自然也就提升的很快。

    陈峰把这个发现记在心里，随后开始整理今晚的收获。

    心念一动，将个人空间中的物品逐一取出，摆在茶几上。

    一共一株成年灰伞肺菇，二十四株幼年灰伞肺菇，一块铁鄂灰蜚的心脏，还有两片金属化的颚叶和几片完整的甲壳碎片。

    陈峰看着茶几上这堆东西，略微想了想。

    那株成年肺菇留着自己用，这个没什么好犹豫的。

    成年肺菇虽然价值高，但今后还能在大墟世界中找到，现在反而是突破【气血关】对自己来说更加重要。

    毕竟自己的实力越强，今后能在大墟中探索到的东西也就越多。

    至于剩下的幼年体，直接挂出去卖就行了。

    陈峰掏出手机打开白鱼APP。
content_en:
In a rental house.

Chen Feng leaned on the sofa and took off his helmet, pulled off his gas mask, and calmed his breathing for a while before his tense nerves gradually relaxed.

I couldn't help but recall the huge bamboo monster I just saw in my mind.

And when I saw the monster, I felt the cold and sticky feeling that penetrated my mind.

He was very sure that among the information on alien creatures he had found, there was no such monster that could affect the mind at a glance.

"Is this... pollution?"

Chen Feng thought of a possibility.

Actually,

The essence of the alienation of organisms in a high-spirited environment is evolution, which is the exploration of excellent traits deep in genes.

There have been rumors on the Internet that the higher the concentration of spiritual energy in the restricted areas of the real world, the more likely it is that a kind of pollution will appear...

Or it might be more appropriate to call it "distortion".

It will lead the evolution of living things in some indescribable direction.

Such creatures are generally extremely dangerous and possess all kinds of strange and incredible abilities.

You know, the concentration of spiritual energy in restricted areas in the real world is only about three times normal.

If this rumor is true, then there may be more terrifying monsters in this world where the concentration of spiritual energy has reached five times.

Chen Feng shook his head and suppressed his thoughts for the time being. It was useless to think about it.

He lowered his head and looked at the wound on his right forearm. It had been sealed by Tianheng spray, leaving only a white film covering it, and it was faintly itchy.

It's obviously being repaired, and it should take less than two days to recover.

Chen Feng withdrew his gaze and opened the panel to take a look.

[Basic Fighting Skills Lv.1 Experience: 85/100]

Well, it went up three points?

Chen Feng recalled it. He remembered that before he entered the world of Daxu, his experience value in fighting skills was 82 points.

In other words, the fight with the iron-jawed gray fly just now directly increased the experience by 3 points!

Chen Feng's eyes lit up slightly.

You know, when he was in a training class at school some time ago,

A class lasted ninety minutes, sparring plus practical exercises, and I was almost exhausted, but my experience points didn't move at all.

Sometimes it takes a week of continuous classes to gain a point or two.

As a result, I fought for my life with a cockroach in the big market, and I got it at three o'clock.

"True knowledge emerges between life and death..."

Chen Feng smacked his lips, which is understandable.

No matter how the training in the classroom simulates actual combat, it is still safe after all. The body knows that it will not die, so it cannot push out its potential.

But it's different in Daxu.

Adrenaline surges with every life-or-death fight, every muscle and nerve in the body is operating at its limit, and fighting skills naturally improve quickly.

Chen Feng kept this discovery in mind and then began to sort out tonight's harvest.

With a thought, he took out the items in his personal space one by one and placed them on the coffee table.

There was a total of one adult Pleurotus cinerea, twenty-four juvenile Pleurotus cinerea, a heart of an iron-clawed worm, two metalized jaw lobes and several complete carapace fragments.

Chen Feng looked at the pile of things on the coffee table and thought for a moment.

Keep the adult lung mushroom for your own use. There is nothing to hesitate about.

Although adult lung mushrooms are of high value, they can still be found in the Great Ruins world in the future. Now, it is more important for me to break through the [Qi and Blood Pass].

After all, the stronger you are, the more things you can explore in the ruins in the future.

As for the remaining juvenile bodies, just put them up and sell them.

Chen Feng took out his mobile phone and opened the Baiyu APP.
